spectral_synchronization.published_family: Singer, Angular Synchronization by Eigenvectors and Semidefinite Programming, 2011
spectral_synchronization.inputs: six parity bits, six reliability tags, one anchor

dawid_skene_regularized.inputs: 3 votes per nonanchor query, obtained from overlapping parity paths; no reliability tags

wrench_style_ds_unsmoothed.published_family: WRENCH implementation of Dawid-Skene, Zhang et al., NeurIPS 2021
wrench_style_ds_unsmoothed.implementation: local specialization of source, not original import
wrench_style_ds_unsmoothed.relative_cost: iterative EM, no per-report reliability metadata

posterior_soft.published_family: exact Bayesian inference on binary constraints
posterior_soft.implementation: 8-state exact enumeration under supplied independent noise model
posterior_soft.inputs: six bits, six reliability tags, one anchor

joint.inputs: same reports, tags, anchor and graphs as matched posterior-soft
joint.relative_cost: above posterior arithmetic plus differentiable eight-state model loss
